title: Sar Ka Paw Battalion Rejoins KNLA Brigade 4 With 50-Plus Fighters
detail: The Sar Ka Paw Battalion, previously expelled from the Karen National Liberation Army-affiliated KTLA, formally rejoined KNLA Brigade 4 on September 21, 2026, bringing more than 50 fighters back into the Karen National Union's command structure.

media.caption: MoeMaKa CDM domestic news digest reporting the Sar Ka Paw Battalion's reintegration into KNLA Brigade 4.

title: Junta Troops Extrajudicially Kill 21-Year-Old Civilian Near Pandawgyi Village, Laymyethna Township
detail: Ko Kyaw Thet Oo, 21, was extrajudicially killed by Myanmar military junta forces near Pandawgyi Village, Laymyethna Township, Ayeyarwady Region, on September 21, 2026. The killing occurred amid a junta ground offensive by Light Infantry Division 66 and allied Pyu Saw Htee militias to recapture Arakan Army-held territory in Laymyethna, Yekyi and Thabaung townships, part of the broader 'Operation 4926' campaign launched September 4.

media.caption: BNI report on the Laymyethna Township offensive, including the extrajudicial killing near Pandawgyi Village.
